note: Spink County has no queryable zoning district layer. The county zoning ordinance (Title 17) adopts an Official Zoning Map that is not published as a file; the county maps page lists only commissioner, fire, school and precinct maps. The City of Redfield publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (CityMapZoning11x17.pdf) and a page with no GIS service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Spink zoning service; the county's Beacon viewer (Schneider) is not a public ArcGIS service and returned 403 to automated access. Doland, Frankfort and Northville publish no zoning GIS found.
